faqs.q: What is the 1 in 1500# RF globe valve rated 3,705 psi used for?
faqs.a: It is a flanged 1 in globe valve in ANSI 1500 class, rated 3,705 psi working pressure, used for isolation and throttling on analyser and sample-line control. The body is Forged AISI 4130 with F6NM trim with Inconel 625 overlay seats. Brand: Cameron.

faqs.q: What do the words 1 in x 1500# RF in the title of this globe valve mean?
faqs.a: 1 in is the nominal size, 1500# is the ANSI pressure class and RF is raised-face flange ends, so the title describes a 1 in globe valve in class 1500 with raised-face flanges. The working pressure of 3,705 psi follows from the class.

faqs.q: What end connections does the 1 in ANSI 1500 globe valve have?
faqs.a: Both ends are 1 in 1500# ANSI raised-face flanges, built to ASME B16.5 bolting and gasket pattern. Match the mating flange to the same 1 in class 1500, because the flange class sets the pressure limit at the joint. For gaskets, see the [globe valves shelf](/c/oilfield-globe-valves) and our other flange-ready lines.

faqs.q: Which pressure class should I pick between ANSI 1500 and ANSI 600 for a globe valve?
faqs.a: Pick the class from your line's maximum working pressure at operating temperature, then take the next class up. This listing is ANSI 1500 at 3,705 psi; the 3 in ANSI 600 globe valve in the same range is rated 1,480 psi. See the [3 in 600# globe valve](/p/globe-valve-3-in-600-rf-1-480-psi-sour-service) for that rating.

faqs.q: What is the pressure rating of the 1 in ANSI 1500 globe valve, and what does it mean?
faqs.a: The working pressure is 3,705 psi for ANSI 1500 class. Hydrostatic shell testing is at 1.5 times working pressure and the seat is tested before dispatch. The flange class is the limiting item at the joint, so match upstream and downstream flanges to ANSI 1500.

faqs.q: What is the body of the 1 in 1500# globe valve made from?
faqs.a: The body is Forged AISI 4130 — NACE MR0175 compliant. Trim is F6NM trim with Inconel 625 overlay seats — NACE compliant, and the stem is packed with Graphite + Inconel braided packing (sour). Ask for the material test report if your project requires traceability.

faqs.q: Is the 1 in ANSI 1500 globe valve suitable for sour (H2S) service?
faqs.a: Yes. The 1 in class 1500 listing states NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 compliance, material class EE, covering the Forged AISI 4130 body, trim and packing. Send your H2S, CO2 and chloride data and we confirm the fit. Design specification stated: API 6D.

faqs.q: What fits with a 1 in ANSI 1500 globe valve in a line?
faqs.a: Use ANSI 1500 raised-face flanges, matching studs and a gasket suited to the class, with check and isolation valves of the same flange class. For throttling service the listing also advises a matching positioner and instrument-air panel. Browse the [oilfield globe valves shelf](/c/oilfield-globe-valves).

faqs.q: Can the 1 in ANSI 1500 globe valve throttle flow as well as isolate?
faqs.a: Yes, the 1 in ANSI 1500 globe valve is built for both, at 3,705 psi working pressure. The plug closes on a circular seat and the flow path gives a near-linear flow curve, which gates, balls and plugs do not give. Install with the flow direction marked on the body and read the [needle and globe valve guide](/blog/needle-globe-and-instrumentation-valves).

faqs.q: How does the 1 in ANSI 1500 globe valve compare with a gate or ball valve?
faqs.a: Globe valves throttle and isolate but lose more pressure when fully open, while gate and ball valves give full-bore isolation with low pressure drop. Use the 1 in class 1500 globe valve for control or bleed duty at 3,705 psi; use a [gate valve](/c/oilfield-gate-valves) or [ball valve](/c/oilfield-ball-valves) for on-off isolation.

faqs.q: What is an API 6A globe valve used for on a wellhead?
faqs.a: An API 6A globe valve throttles and shuts off flow on wellhead, injection and manifold lines, in sizes 2-1/16" to 7-1/16" and 3,000 to 15,000 psi working pressure. It has a stellite seat, a blow-out proof stem and a plunger or parabolic disc.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressure classes does the API 6A globe valve come in?
faqs.a: The listing covers 2-1/16" to 7-1/16" nominal bore at 3,000 to 15,000 psi working pressure, with API 6A flanged or studded ends. Give the bore, working pressure and end connection on the enquiry and we match the exact model.

faqs.q: Which disc should I choose on an API 6A globe valve: plunger, parabolic or flat?
faqs.a: Use the plunger disc for general throttling, a parabolic disc for finer control over a wider opening, and a flat disc for on-off duty. The seat is stellite on all versions. Tell us the flow range and pressure drop and we recommend the disc.

faqs.q: What pressure range is the API 6A globe valve rated for?
faqs.a: It is rated 3,000 to 15,000 psi working pressure, the API 6A pressure class you order. Hydrostatic body and seat tests are done to API 6A at the PSL ordered, and gas tests are added at PSL 3G and 4.

faqs.q: What material classes and temperature classes are available on the API 6A globe valve?
faqs.a: Body material is offered in API 6A material classes AA to HH, with DD to HH for sour service, and temperature classes K to X. Give the class your well data requires; we confirm it against the operator's specification.

faqs.q: What API standard and test levels does the API 6A globe valve meet?
faqs.a: It is built to API 6A and listed with CE-PED, at PSL 1 to 4 and PR1 or PR2. The valve is supplied with API 6A documentation for the PSL ordered: material certificates, heat-treatment and NDE records, the hydrostatic test record and the dimensional report.

faqs.q: What end connections can an API 6A globe valve be ordered with?
faqs.a: API 6A flanged or studded ends, as listed, with clamp hubs or hammer unions also possible when you state them on the enquiry. Match the bore and pressure to the mating flange. See the [globe valves shelf](/c/oilfield-globe-valves) for ANSI-flanged alternatives.

faqs.q: Which way round is an API 6A globe valve installed?
faqs.a: Install it so flow enters under the disc, following the arrow marked on the body. A globe valve is directional, so fitting it backwards changes the seat loading. Read the [needle, globe and instrumentation valve guide](/blog/needle-globe-and-instrumentation-valves) for line-up practice.

faqs.q: Where is an API 6A globe valve typically installed?
faqs.a: It is typically installed in injection, bleed-off, sampling and bypass lines. It operates with an impact handwheel, and an actuator can be added on request. For plant pipework in ANSI classes see the [2 in 900# sour globe valve](/p/globe-valve-2-in-900-rf-2-220-psi-sour-service).

faqs.q: API 6A globe valve or ANSI globe valve: which one for a wellhead line?
faqs.a: Use the API 6A globe valve for wellhead and manifold lines at 3,000 to 15,000 psi, where API 6A flanges and PSL levels apply. Use an ANSI globe valve such as the [2 in 300# sour globe valve](/p/globe-valve-2-in-300-rf-740-psi-sour-service) for plant pipework in ASME classes.

faqs.q: Can an API 6A globe valve be supplied from Dubai with documentation?
faqs.a: Yes. It is built to order and supplied from Dubai with API 6A documentation and the test record, and exported worldwide. Third-party witnessing and operator specification reviews can be arranged on request; list any specification with the enquiry.

faqs.a: The API 6A globe valve is built to order and supplied from Dubai with API 6A documentation. Send the bore, pressure, end connections, material class, PSL and operator through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm lead time and price.
